{"kind": "AssistantMessage", "content": [{"text": "All levels (DEBUG/INFO/WARN/ERROR) log correctly through Logback, confirming the SLF4J binding resolves to a single, working implementation.\n\n## Summary\n\n**Root cause**: `pom.xml` declared two competing SLF4J bindings simultaneously:\n- `logback-classic:1.2.3` (binds SLF4J \u2192 Logback)\n- `log4j-slf4j-impl:2.20.0` (binds SLF4J \u2192 Log4j2)\n\nBoth jars ship a class named `org.slf4j.impl.StaticLoggerBinder` with incompatible bytecode. Combined with a separately pinned, stale `slf4j-api:1.7.25` that disagreed with the versions Spring Boot's own `spring-boot-starter-logging` expected (1.7.36), the JVM loaded a `StaticLoggerBinder` whose contract didn't match what `LoggerFactory` expected \u2014 producing the `NoSuchMethodError` at runtime despite a clean compile (annotation-based linking isn't checked until the method is actually invoked).\n\n**Fix applied to `/app/service/pom.xml`**:\n1. Added `dependencyManagement` importing the `spring-boot-dependencies:2.7.14` BOM so slf4j-api, logback, and jackson versions are aligned project-wide instead of fixed by whichever library's own POM request won.\n2. Removed `log4j-slf4j-impl` (and its transitive `log4j-core`/`log4j-api`) entirely \u2014 a project should only have one SLF4J binding.\n3. Removed the hardcoded stale `logback-classic:1.2.3` / `slf4j-api:1.7.25` versions, re-declaring both without a version so they resolve via the BOM (now 1.2.12 / 1.7.36), consistent with everything Spring Boot pulls in transitively.\n4. Added an exclusion on `kafka-clients` for its transitive `slf4j-api`, and an exclusion on `elasticsearch-rest-high-level-client` for `commons-logging`, replacing the latter with `jcl-over-slf4j` to route it through the same unified SLF4J/Logback pipeline.\n\n**Verified**: `mvn dependency:tree -Dverbose` now shows a single `slf4j-api:1.7.36` and single `logback-classic:1.2.12` with zero version conflicts; `mvn clean compile` and `mvn clean test` both succeed (4/4 tests pass) with real DEBUG/INFO/WARN/ERROR log output confirming the binding works at runtime."}], "model": "claude-sonnet-5", "parent_tool_use_id": null, "error": null, "usage": {"input_tokens": 2, "cache_creation_input_tokens": 881, "cache_read_input_tokens": 70381, "cache_creation": {"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens": 881, "ephemeral_1h_input_tokens": 0}, "output_tokens": 2, "service_tier": "standard", "inference_geo": "global"}, "message_id": "msg_011CfkJgs7cccagMJn3mPUkV", "stop_reason": null, "session_id": "27130c94-421d-4b5d-a23c-e39d84178363", "uuid": "244ec634-3881-446d-9ffc-0e796936b852"}
